body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark the space until the start of your next turn. A willing creature standing there gains +1 Fortitude and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement while it remains there.

surges.html: An adjacent empty space gains the same mark.
One willing creature on a mark reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: anchor one marked space. Trigger: a willing occupant would be pushed or pulled. Echo: reduce that movement by 1 unit.
